scores.evidence: q3 still has objectiveId o3 and bloom understand. The prompt asks what happens in a fresh session, and the new answer c 「昨日の会話は見えないが、伝え直すか開き直せば続けられる」 tests that o3 idea. Every objective still has 2 or more graded questions (o1: q1, q5; o2: q2, q6; o3: q3, q4, q7, q8, q9).

hook-problem gives a concrete pain in three sentences (「ファイルを貼り付け、答えを書き写すことになりがちです」) and states the lesson's goal. The ungraded predict q0 uses chat, completion and memory as distractors, and the lesson corrects all three later.

I re-scored this because the lesson moved from the vibe-coding course to its own claude-code course, so its prerequisites now point into another course. The cross-course references still resolve. 「Gitのコミット（commit）の意味がわかる（バイブコーディング第5章）」 matches vibe-ch5 「第5章｜GitHubワークフロー完全理解」, and 「VS Codeを使ったことがある（バイブコーディング第3章）」 matches vibe-ch3 「第3章｜開発環境コックピット（VS Code）」. The p-commit troubleshoot 「バイブコーディング第5章の `git config`」 also still names a real chapter. The course name makes these references clear across the course boundary. The course description now says push is required (「Gitのcommitとpushの意味がわかる人向けです」), which partly closes the earlier push gap for learners who start from the course page. The lesson's own prerequisites still say only commit. Two gaps are unchanged: q2 and the cloud row depend on push, and install-how expands WSL only in English (「WSL（Windows Subsystem for Linux）」).

Re-scored because practice-steps grew. measure.mjs: 「prose 1659 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2483 · practice reading 842 · questions 10 · practice sections 1 · est 16.1 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 16)」. Practice reading went from 801 to 842 characters, and the estimate still rounds to estMinutes 16. The p-start expect is now 3 short sentences (「初めてのフォルダでは、信頼の確認が出ます。自分で作ったフォルダなので、承認します。入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます。」), each well under 60 characters. 「信頼の確認」 is plain Japanese, not a new technical term. Lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. The earlier load points (install segment term count, repeated table labels) are unchanged.

Re-scored because practice-steps changed. The ①–⑤ markers were removed from the step titles (「質問して、変更を1つ頼む」「予想してから差分を見る」「変更を説明してもらう」「コミットして確かめる」). The step bodies still point back to the example: 「1-5の①を送り」, 「1-5の②と同じく」 and 「1-5の⑤を送り」. p-diff and p-explain no longer cite ③ and ④, so the mapping from the example to the practice is a little weaker for those two steps. Their titles still mirror the example steps (「④ 変更を説明してもらう」 ↔ 「変更を説明してもらう」). The earlier gaps are unchanged: the example never shows the page being committed first, and practice-steps is the only level of fading.

q3's new c does not give the answer away. The density rule is met (q1–q4). q1-a still restates the loop-diagram description, while d (「原因を推測してコードを書き換え、そのまま完了と報告する」) differs in its opening, so q1 can still be answered by matching words.

Each wrong option of q3 has feedback of 2 sentences or fewer that names the misconception (a 「まっさらなコンテキストで始まります」, b 「フォルダが同じでも…昨日の会話は入りません」, d 「消えるのは会話の記憶で、ファイルではありません」). The other misconceptions from the brief are corrected in q0, q1, q5, install-node, q7-c, q4-a and q9-a.

Re-scored because loop-table and surfaces-table changed. Both tables keep 2 columns, and the first columns are now short (「チャット」「補完」「Claude Code」; 「CLI」「IDE拡張」「アプリ」「クラウド」), which gives the second column more room on a phone. Every cell now opens with the full name, so the header 「場面と、知っておくこと」 matches the content less well, and in the CLI row the label is repeated three times (see niceToHave). The diagram, its caption and alt, and the absence of decorative images are unchanged.

Re-scored because p-start changed. A learner on a first run now gets a warning about the folder-trust prompt instead of a surprise: 「初めてのフォルダでは、信頼の確認が出ます。」 The expect also gives a reason to approve (「自分で作ったフォルダなので、承認します。」), which models a sound rule for trusting a folder. Its success signal is still observable (「入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます。」). One weakness: the approve action now sits in expect, while md only says 「上のコマンドを1行ずつ実行します。」 (see niceToHave). Everything else is unchanged. The task is authentic and runs in a throwaway folder, every step has an expect, practice-checklist has 6 observable criteria, the hint ladder has at most two rungs (hint + troubleshoot), and p-commit has no hint.
summary-points comes after the exam. summary-next asks a reflection question tied to the practice (「演習で、確認なしで進んだ操作はありましたか。」). The 7 cards match the body and are cited, and askTutor follows.

Re-scored because p-start changed. The added sentence 「初めてのフォルダでは、信頼の確認が出ます。」 agrees with the fact files: cross-lesson-facts.md item 8 treats a trust dialog for an untrusted folder as standard interactive behaviour (「`claude -p` … without a trust dialog」), and facts-cc-01-first-session.md lists the 「trust dialog」 as a built-in safeguard on the security page. It also matches cc-05 (「初めてのフォルダなので、信頼の確認が出ます。」) and cc-09 (「初めてのフォルダーでは、先に `claude` で信頼の確認に答えます。」). This addresses the first-start part of the previous round's factual doubt. practice-steps cites cc-quickstart, cc-terminal-guide and cc-how-it-works, and the lesson's sources do not include the security page, so I cannot trace the trust dialog to a cited page (niceToHave). The 「入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます」 detail is unchanged and still cannot be traced to a source.

Re-scored because install-how and both tables changed. The prose is in です・ます, warm, and has no banned phrases. Acronyms get their expansion at first use (API, WSL, CLI). The table cells are noun-phrase fragments, which is acceptable in a table. Glossary terms are still used in the cells (「クラウドセッション」). The code labels are still mixed: install-unix uses 「macOS・Linux・WSL」, while install-win uses 「PowerShell (Windows)」.

Re-scored because the table cells changed. Only jp is declared, and it is complete. The tables keep their captions (「見るものと、することの違い」「4つのサーフェスと、向いている場面」) and header rows, and each row starts with the full name, so a screen reader gets the meaning even though the labels are short. The diagram has Japanese labels and full alt text, and the links are descriptive.

niceToHave: lesson level vs course level (new with the move): the lesson has "level": "beginner", but content/courses/claude-code/course.json has "level": "intermediate". Choose one deliberately. The course-level prerequisites (cd/ls, commit and push) fit intermediate for the course, while beginner fits this first lesson. If the mismatch is intended, no change is needed.

prerequisites (raised again; the course description now says push): to match content/courses/claude-code/course.json, change the second item to 「Gitのコミット（commit）とプッシュ（push）の意味がわかる（バイブコーディング第5章）」. q2 and surfaces-table depend on push.

prerequisites (new with the move): now that バイブコーディング is a separate course, consider naming it as a course so learners know to look elsewhere: 「…（コース「バイブコーディング」第5章）」. The current text is still clear, so this is optional (ja-editor owns the wording).

Move it into md and keep expect for the result. md: 「上のコマンドを1行ずつ実行します。初めてのフォルダでは信頼の確認が出るので、自分で作ったフォルダであることを確かめて承認します。」 expect: 「入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます。」 (ja-editor owns the final wording)

factual doubt (p-start expect): 「入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます」 is an uncited UI detail. A safer wording, which matches cc-05: 「Claude Codeが起動し、入力欄が表示されます。」

summary: Verification round. review-scope exited 0. Only lesson.courseId changed (vibe-coding → claude-code), 1 of 88 parts (2%). No blocks, sections or objectives changed. The previous review had no open must-fix items, and the round it verified had none either, so there are no resolved entries. I reviewed the change and its effects. The cross-course references (バイブコーディング第3章 and 第5章, the p-commit troubleshoot) still name real chapters. summary-next and the permission-mode glossary entry name 「第2回｜任せる範囲を決める：権限モードと巻き戻し」, which matches the next link to cc-02-permissions in course.json. The prompt blocks' target "claude-code" names the tool, not the course, so they are unaffected. The move caused no regressions, so there are no new must-fix items. I re-scored prior; it stays at 3. The other 12 criteria are carried over. validate shows 0 errors and lint --strict 0 warnings. measure.mjs gives prose 1659 and est 16.1 min (estMinutes 16). New nice-to-haves: the lesson level (beginner) differs from the course level (intermediate), and the prerequisites could match the course description's commit-and-push requirement.
